groups.title: Interfaces in Go
groups.question: Explain how interfaces work in Go, and why they are different from interfaces in Java or C#.

followUps.Implicit Interface Satisfaction: A type never says it implements an interface. How does Go decide it does, and why is that useful?
followUps.Interface Values & Nil Traps: A function returns a nil pointer as an error, yet err != nil is true. Why?

groups.title: Struct Composition
groups.question: Explain how you reuse behavior between types in Go without inheritance.

followUps.Embedding vs Inheritance: What happens when an embedded type and the outer struct both define the same method?
followUps.Struct Tags & Reflection: You misspell a json struct tag. What happens, and why don't you get an error?

groups.title: Generics
groups.question: Explain how generics work in Go, and how you decide whether to use them.

followUps.Type Parameters & Constraints: What do the any and comparable constraints allow, and why define your own constraint?
followUps.When Not to Use Generics: When would an interface or a little duplicated code be clearer than a generic function?

groups.title: Type Assertions & Switches
groups.question: Explain how you get the concrete type back out of an interface value safely.

followUps.Type Assertions: What is the difference between v := x.(T) and v, ok := x.(T)?
followUps.Type Switches: When is a type switch the right tool, and what does it look like?
